svg.title: Thymosin alpha-1 in sepsis: the bigger trial found no survival benefit
svg.desc: 28-day death, thymosin alpha-1 vs control, with 95% confidence intervals. Values below 1 favour thymosin alpha-1. ETASS 2013, 361 people: risk ratio 0.74 (0.54 to 1.02), 26.0% vs 35.0% died. TESTS 2025, 1,106 people, placebo controlled: hazard ratio 0.99 (0.77 to 1.27), 23.4% vs 24.1%. Meta-analysis of 11 trials: odds ratio 0.73 (0.59 to 0.90) overall, but 0.82 (0.65 to 1.03) in high-quality trials and 0.86 (0.68 to 1.08) in multicentre trials.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
